visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a red product box emblazoned with the "Nintendo Switch 2" logo resting on a white, textured surface. A person's hand enters the frame, lifting the top lid to reveal a black handheld gaming console wrapped in protective clear plastic. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the sleek texture of the device. (2) The hand carefully removes the console and proceeds to unwrap a set of Joy-Con controllers, one vibrant blue and the other a deep orange-red. The camera follows the movement in a handheld style, creating a sense of intimacy and immediacy. The background reveals a clean indoor home setting with neutral-colored furniture and soft ambient lighting. (3) A physical game case for "Mario Kart World" is presented to the camera, showcasing high-saturation character graphics. The hand holds the box steady, allowing the viewer to inspect the details of the packaging and labels. The filming remains focused on the objects, with the person's hands being the only visible human element in this phase. (4) The scene transitions to the console's screen, which displays a system setup interface in Traditional Chinese characters. The hand is shown manipulating the detached Joy-Con, with the screen showing a graphic representation of the controller pairing process. The camera captures the sharp resolution and color depth of the handheld's display in a medium close-up. (5) A montage of the console's home menu follows, scrolling through several game icons such as "Capcom Arcade Stadium" and "Fire Emblem Engage." The interface is clean and modern, with the camera zooming in slightly to emphasize the variety of software available. The lighting from the screen reflects softly on the user's hands. (6) The final phase shows a person sitting in a relaxed posture, with their legs visible in a casual pair of shorts as they hold the console. A snippet of gameplay from a 3D fantasy action game is shown, with the camera capturing the smooth movement of the character on screen. The video ends with a wide shot of the person holding the device.
